_comment: Proposal schema for the candidate layer (Phase 3). Every model-produced proposal is candidate-tier (authority level 7) by construction. The queue (_proposals/proposals.jsonl) is inert until a human moves it. evidence_audit.py validates each record against this schema; a proposal missing its required evidence fields is AUTO-REJECTED in the audit report (never auto-deleted - the human decides from the report).

source_passage._desc: Required evidence anchor for all kinds except intake-registration. Quote must be verbatim text that exists in the file at path.

intake-registration._desc: Register a new original + derivative. Evidence = the artifact itself: original_path must exist and sha256 must be 64 hex chars.

retirement-request._desc: Request to retire/supersede a record. Requires stronger evidence: passage + explicit superseded_by or error documentation.

object-create._desc: Propose a NEW canonical object. No closed object kind: carry optional labels only. Use instead of object-note when no object record exists yet.

object-update._desc: Revise an existing object page. Use instead of object-note (which appends an observation) and record-correction (which fixes one field value).

relation-create._desc: Propose a NEW relation-object. Use instead of relation-edge (which asserts a typed link where the endpoints already exist) when no relation record exists yet.

relation-amend._desc: Revise an existing relation record. Use instead of link-repair (which fixes a broken wikilink address).

claim-amend._desc: Revise an existing claim's text or scope. Use instead of claim-amendment (which challenges a claim's support or permission).

lineage-link._desc: Link a record to a lineage or genesis event.

research-question._desc: File an open research question. The passage is the context that motivates it, not an answer.

capture-promotion._desc: Promote captures into a proposal. Evidence is the capture: refs on the record, not a quoted passage.
